coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Across seven ground-truth variable categories, training regime and game rules match; evaluation protocol and reasoning performance partially match. Model, learning parameters, and gameplay outcomes do not match. Counting the two partial matches as half credit gives 3/7, or 43%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes a fixed Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B, and omits learning-rate and KL-penalty variations. It preserves shared evaluation splits and metrics but omits batch size 128 and sequence length 2048. Its benchmark suite overlaps only on BBH, and arithmetic macro improvement replaces geometric mean scores. Attacker/defender win rates and non-adversarial gameplay success are not measured as dependent variables.
